battle_phases.completion_condition: Ansel is deployed at frame 1440 with all four interception lanes occupied.

handoff_requirements: Ansel immediately has baseline range to both central blocking tiles.
Outer tanks remain alive despite their slower single-target clearance.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla stop central runners and initial officers.
Beagle and Spot stop outer runners using supported base armor and three-block capacity.
Lancet's deployment heal bridges early HP; its normal healing supports the lower lanes.
battle_phases.start_condition: Battle begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Fang survives its first runner without crediting Lancet's later deployment heal before that duel ends.
Both vanguards survive until Ansel establishes baseline central healing.
Vanilla survives and supplies the frame-750 DP grant.

battle_phases.completion_condition: #3 is destroyed before frame 2610 and #4 before frame 3270; both medics remain active.

handoff_requirements: Kroos yields an empty [2,7] tile to Steward after #3 destruction.
Plume yields its deployment slot after #4 destruction.
Civilian release is observed separately from later safe arrival.
responsibilities: Kroos clears #3 from the eastern high ground.
Plume clears #4 from the tile east of Spot.
Hibiscus replaces Lancet and shares baseline coverage of Ansel and the eastern caster tiles.
battle_phases.start_condition: Opening formation survives and the second Vanilla DP activation is available.
survival_dependencies: Outer officers remain held west of the clearers' intended target areas.
Ansel survives until mutual coverage is established.
Actual roadblock durability permits the stated working windows.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is destroyed before frame 4500 with both medics still sustaining their assigned patients.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery can kill casters, medics or civilians and invalidate the later formation even if all deployments were legal.

handoff_requirements: Observe artillery destruction before withdrawing Steward.
No protected target dies during eastern movement or western restraint.
responsibilities: Steward attacks eastern exposures through its actual rotated range.
Lava adds supported single-target arts damage and central damage.
Ansel's first boost hands eastern healing pressure to Hibiscus's first boost.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward occupies [2,7] UP and Lava joins at frame 3300.
survival_dependencies: Mutual range produces actual timely healing under damage and competing patient demand.
Steward survives exposure before and during the first boost.
Unforced target selection leaves sufficient artillery damage after attacks diverted to other hostiles.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The schedule is exhausted after second 211 and the frame-6630 arts reinforcement is established.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost blocker or excess queue produces leaks; exhausted spawns alone cannot establish success.
battle_phases.goal: Preserve every corridor through the final modeled spawns.
handoff_requirements: Retreat and replacement on each shared ground tile occur in the listed order.
Upper outer enemies are cleared before Kroos yields [2,5] to redeployed Steward.
No unsupported defender healing is required.
responsibilities: Noir Corne and Cardigan inherit the central queues.
Kroos shortens Beagle's upper outer queue.
Fresh Plume replaces Spot for the final lower outer officers.
Lava supplies central arts damage while Ansel heals central blockers.
battle_phases.start_condition: Artillery has been removed and central replacement actions begin at frame 4500.
survival_dependencies: Beagle survives its unhealed workload until Kroos reinforcement and thereafter.
Spot survives until frame 5400; fresh Plume survives the final lower officers.
Ansel remains alive and can service both central queues.

battle_phases.completion_condition: No active hostile remains before frame 9900, with zero leaks.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Withdrawing arts against a surviving armored queue leaves the final release phase unsupported.

handoff_requirements: Verify hostile clearance independently of spawn exhaustion.
Only then transfer both caster slots to western clearers at frame 9900.
responsibilities: Both arts operators clear armored and runner queues.
Both medics sustain their covered formation without assuming unsupported talents.
battle_phases.start_condition: Redeployed Steward and Lava support the late central defenders.
survival_dependencies: Central three-block capacity contains queues until actual kills.
Casters and Ansel survive every required cleanup skill window.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both western restraints are destroyed, both civilians safely arrive, remaining life is positive, no leaks or protected deaths occurred, spawns are exhausted and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missing civilian, intact restraint, protected death or absent arrival prevents project acceptance regardless of hostile kill count.
battle_phases.goal: Destroy western restraints and complete both protected-target objectives.
handoff_requirements: Roadblock destruction releases civilian movement through the supported special-blocking mechanism.
No ordinary operator is assigned civilian blocking, attack or navigation control.
responsibilities: Kroos attacks #1 and Durin attacks #2 until destruction.
Retain the four interception positions and both medics.
Count two explicit safe arrivals independently of kills and device destruction.
battle_phases.start_condition: Hostile clearance gate has passed and Kroos and Durin deploy at frame 9900.
survival_dependencies: Both protected targets are still alive when final release starts.
Western clearers remain deployed through actual device destruction.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward and Lava destroy artillery; mutually covered medics sustain the damage sources. Required destruction precedes frame-4500 Steward withdrawal.
Kroos clears #3 by its frame-2610 withdrawal. Beagle intercepts outer officers at column 4. Late Kroos clears #1; record the upper civilian's safe arrival.
Fang hands upper central interception to Noir Corne. Ansel heals; Lava and later redeployed Steward clear armored queues.
Vanilla hands lower central interception to Cardigan. Ansel heals; Lava and later Steward supply arts damage.
Beagle supplies continuous three-block upper outer interception. Kroos supplies late damage so waiting officers do not exhaust Beagle's unhealed HP.
Spot handles the opening and paired lower officers; fresh Plume assumes the final separated arrivals at second 180.
Plume clears #4 by second 109, before prolonged exposure to the paired officers. Durin eventually clears #2. Record lower civilian arrival independently.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception and automatic DP until frame 4500.
Opening lower central interception and manual DP until frame 4950.
Permanent upper outer three-block interception; initial survival uses base armor.
Lower outer three-block interception until frame 5400; no healing-skill credit.
Opening deployment heal and lower central/outer healing until frame 2460.
Baseline healing of both central blockers, Hibiscus, eastern Steward and Lava.
Eastern upper restraint #3 clearance before yielding this tile to Steward.
Eastern lower restraint #4 clearance during the outer spawn gap.
Baseline healing of Ansel, eastern Steward and Lava; central blockers are outside its baseline range.
Artillery damage across the eastern vertical route, including its far center-range cell [5,7].
Eastern artillery damage and arts damage on both central blocking tiles.
Three-block upper central replacement for Fang.
Upper outer damage support after artillery removal.
Three-block lower central replacement for Vanilla; basic attacks only.
Fresh lower outer interception for the final separated officers.
Redeployed arts support covering both central blockers.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward [2,7] UP covers the eastern vertical route from row 2 through its center extension at row 5. Lava [5,6] DOWN adds damage on eastern rows 3-5 and both central blocking tiles. Competing hostile targets can reduce artillery damage.
formation_structure.clearance: Kroos attacks #3 from [2,7] DOWN while the opening upper officer is held farther west. Plume attacks #4 from [6,5] RIGHT while Spot holds the opening lower officer behind it. Neither clearance role assumes player-selected targets.
formation_structure.final_release: After hostile clearance, both arts slots transfer to western clearers. Both civilians must independently reach their objectives.
formation_structure.healing: Ansel [2,6] UP and Hibiscus [5,7] DOWN cover each other and both eastern casters within baseline ranges. Ansel additionally covers [3,5] and [4,5]. Outer blockers have no permanent medic coverage after Lancet withdraws.
formation_structure.late: Noir Corne and Cardigan take central three-block duties. Kroos reduces Beagle's outer queue; fresh Plume replaces Spot after its early paired wave. Steward later returns facing UP at [2,5] for central armor clearance.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla retain central interception. Beagle and Spot replace the prior fragile outer duelists from the opening. Lancet supplies the deployment heal and temporary lower healing; Ansel assumes central healing at second 48.
formation_structure.protection: Outer blockers occupy column 4 between the two restraint columns. Their intended blocked-officer positions must remain outside the 1.2 attack radius of restrained civilians. Moving officers can still damage civilians before interception.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet and deploy Hibiscus, establishing mutual medic coverage.
After Vanilla's DP activation, withdraw Kroos and install Steward on [2,7]; #3 destruction is a required handoff.
Withdraw Plume after required #4 destruction, opening Lava's slot.
Deploy Lava with both medics already covering its tile.
Replace Fang with Noir Corne in listed order; withdraw Steward only after the required artillery kill.
Redeploy Kroos to reduce upper outer queue duration.
Replace Vanilla with Cardigan in listed order.
Replace Spot with fresh Plume after its redeployment cooldown.
Withdraw upper-support Kroos after the last upper outer arrivals have been cleared.
Return Steward to [2,5] UP for central cleanup.
After required hostile clearance, transfer both caster slots to western restraint clearance.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has rarity 1-3 and normal_mode=true. No reserve-mode unit or unsupported talent supplies a required effect.
All deployment tiles are integer [row,col] on legal terrain, with cardinal directions. Forbidden tiles are exactly [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]]. Maximum simultaneous occupancy is eight.

Budget natural DP and only stated live-source skill grants. No refunds, Plume kill DP or unsupported effects are counted. Lava at second 110 has zero arithmetic DP margin; source death invalidates this handoff.
Fang survives until replacement at second 150; Vanilla survives until second 165. Both medics and required arts sources survive their assigned windows. A dead skill source is a survival failure.
#3 is destroyed before Kroos withdraws at second 87; #4 is destroyed before Plume withdraws at second 109. These are hypotheses to verify, not inferred outcomes.
Aim to kill artillery during the contiguous first medic boosts at seconds 100-145; destruction is mandatory before Steward withdraws at second 150. Retreat does not establish a kill.

Beagle survives without permanent outer healing; Spot survives until the fresh Plume handoff. Armor, later damage support and replacement must actually preserve these roles despite possible artillery exposure.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Check actual officer-to-civilian distance and damage; blocker tile centers alone do not prove protection.
No active hostile enemy remains before both arts operators withdraw at second 330. If this gate fails, the fixed clearance transition is unsupported.
Require remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.
Execute the listed tactical actions in order. Failed handoffs invalidate the candidate; downstream tooling must not invent replacement tactics, refunds or timing repairs.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Keep both vanguards alive, establish armored outer interception, execute Vanilla's first DP skill, bridge central survival with Lancet, and deploy Ansel.
Clear #3, begin independent #4 work, establish mutual medic coverage and preserve every budgeted DP source.
Complete #4 release, establish both arts sources, sustain eastern exposure and kill artillery before Steward withdrawal.
Replace central vanguards, reinforce upper outer damage, refresh lower outer interception and hold through the modeled last spawn at second 211.
Use both arts operators to exhaust central queues while all four corridors remain occupied.
After hostile clearance, destroy both western restraints and retain interception and healing until both civilians safely arrive and all acceptance conditions hold.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic +6 DP at modeled seconds 19,44,69,94,119,144 requires uninterrupted survival through each grant.
Supported +6 DP and attack enhancement. The frame-2610 activation precedes Steward deployment.
Boost healing during upper eastern artillery exposure and later central pressure. Baseline geometry already covers assigned patients; no extra-target talent credit.
Continue boosted eastern healing after Ansel's first skill, then support armor and cleanup windows. No talent bonus credited.
Reduce possible artillery damage during upper eastern exposure; ordinary officer damage already reaches the physical minimum without this skill.
Use supported deployment SP and attack-speed enhancement. Credit single-target damage only; active duration pauses time-SP.
Automatic supported double shots for device clearance and upper outer damage; no random critical-hit credit.
Automatic supported enhanced attacks; no highest-defense priority or forced artillery targeting.
Basic attacks and three-block defense only; unsupported healing skill excluded.
Basic attacks and three-block defense only; unsupported self-heal excluded.
Basic attacks only. Initial clearance deployment ends before skill readiness; late interception does not depend on skill activation or kill DP.

tactical_thesis: Use armored outer interceptors at column 4, independent eastern clearers, and mutually covered medics supporting eastern arts operators. Preserve Fang and Vanilla's opening interception and conditional DP, then replace them with three-block defenders. Destroy artillery before withdrawing Steward, reinforce upper outer damage with Kroos, and replace lower outer Spot with fresh Plume. Clear western restraints after hostile clearance. This is an unexecuted hypothesis with explicit survival and clearance handoffs.
